courses.title: The Mysterious Shoulder Joint: Anatomy, Asana and Therapeutics (Minneapolis)
courses.description: A three-day in-person workshop at Devanadi Yoga in Minneapolis on the anatomy and movement of the shoulder. Each day opens with anatomy study, moves into active asana to put it into practice, and closes with restorative 'quiet practice'; open to yoga teachers and committed students, with 18 continuing-education hours.

courses.title: The Pelvis Is Everything: A 3-Day Immersion (Petaluma)
courses.description: A three-day in-person immersion with Judith in Petaluma, California, built on her long-running workshop about the pelvis and its place in asana practice. Booking is through the host studio, linked from her calendar page.
